title: Engine operations
description: The functions index.ts exports, through which the page, the Worker and the tests drive a reign.

entities.name: Start a reign
entities.description: A fresh state with RULES §1 and §2's starting values and a generator seeded from the given seed.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts), the Worker (worker/scores.ts) and the tests call it.
entities.result: A new GameState: month 0, treasury 1000, costs 60, bodyguard 4, every group at its starting popularity and strength. Without a seed, one is drawn with Math.random (the page does this when the server issued none).

entities.name: Play a reign
entities.description: Plays one reign from the welcome screen to the final report, showing every screen through io.show and reading the key it resolves with.
entities.transport: exported async function, playGame(io, state, best)
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page, the Worker's replay and the tests call it.
entities.result: The state is changed in place to the reign's end (alive or escaped set); resolves with { score, best }, best including this reign.
failures: Whatever io.show throws is passed on: the Worker's replay throws when the keys run out, and treats that as a refusal.

entities.name: Take a snapshot
entities.description: The state in RULES' own terms, for comparison step by step with a reference model.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The tests and the parity harness call it.
entities.result: A Snapshot: copies of every field, renamed as RULES names them (pop, str, status, ally, presidentStrength and the rest).

entities.name: Read a key as an answer
entities.description: How the engine reads a raw key: isYes for yes or no, digit for a number from a menu.
entities.transport: exported functions isYes(key) and digit(key, max)
entities.authorization: None: in-process functions. The page uses isYes to choose the key's blip.
entities.result: isYes: true for Y or y only. digit: 1…max for a single digit key in range, else 0.
